After learning of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lens Reekeene]]'s capture, [[Green squad]] set out to '''rescue''' her from the abandoned [[Imperial garrison (Flankers)|garrison]] on [[Flankers]]. The mission was a success, and Green squad escaped with Reekeene before a [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] could engulf the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].

==The battle==
[[Green squad]] learned of [[General/Legends|General Lens Reekeene's]] [[Ambush in the Fakir sector|capture]] by intercepting a communication sent to [[Iyuta]] from the [[Unidentified Imperial scout vessel captain|captain]] of the [[Unidentified Imperial scout vessel|scout ship]] that had ambushed her [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]. Forced to divert to the abandoned [[Imperial garrison (Flankers)|Imperial garrison]] on [[Flankers]], the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] required evacuation from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] before it was destroyed by a [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]]. A [[Unidentified Imperial cruiser (Flankers)|cruiser]] prepared to depart from Iyuta, but Green squad were able to leave first and beat them to Flankers.<ref name="Missing" />

On Flankers, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] captain had dug into the [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] to await rescue. When Green squad arrived in the ''[[Long Shot]]'', he dispatched a single [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE starfighter]] to oppose them, along with whatever weaponry the base still had. Green squad defeated these obstacles and landed, infiltrating the garrison to find their [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]]. As the [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] accelerated, Green squad were able to extract Reekeene and leave the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] just as the Imperial rescue [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] arrived to promptly be destroyed by the [[Star/Legends|star's]] destruction.<ref name="Missing" />
